ladder.label: TOPPING

ladder.next: Trim or tighten stops; next likely support is the daily-cycle timing band (~day 36-42, now day 17).
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 12 · failed · daily cycle day 17).
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)

ladder.next_zh: 减仓或收紧止损；下一个可能的支撑是日线周期的时间窗口 （约第 36-42 天，现为第 17 天）。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量为负；投资者周期失败（跌破起始低点）；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 12 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期第 17 天）。

ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：强卖出/离场形态（-64）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
